card.name: Words before attacked infrastructure targets
card.fires_on: Small linking words or adjectives such as against, vital, critical, of, to, right before a target of attack or damage, like houses, networks, power grid or a fleet. Appears in bombing, war and cyber-attack text.

modes.label: Bombing and military attacks
modes.description: Linking word right before the thing being bombed or crippled in wartime text.
modes.example: the bombing must be directed essentially<< against>> working-class houses.

modes.label: Cyber-security and critical systems
modes.description: Adjective or word before systems that attackers could damage, such as networks or the power grid.
modes.example: its cyber-security force to defend<< critical>> computer networks.

modes.label: Laws on destruction and harm
modes.description: Punctuation or a linking word inside legal wording about destroying or damaging things.
modes.example: as the means of destruction<<,>> damage or injury to any other State Party

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for infrastructure, facilities and destroying or disrupting them.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the thing being attacked or destroyed, such as a power grid, network or city.
